# Run summary statistics

After running `NextPyper`, you can compute comprehensive summary statistics across all samples and pipeline stages using the `nextpyper summarize` command:

```bash
nextpyper summarize --rundir <outdir> --output summary_stats.tsv
```

This generates a tab-separated file (`summary_stats.tsv`) reporting read counts, targeted probe recovery, and sequence yields across each stage of the workflow.

---

## Summary table metrics

The summary table contains the following 13 metrics:

### Sample & read quality metrics

| Column Name | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| **`samples`** | Name of the sample. |
| **`raw_reads`** | Total number of raw sequencing read pairs provided as input. |
| **`trimmed_reads`** | Number of high-quality read pairs remaining after quality and adapter trimming (and plastid cleaning if enabled). |

---

### Locus discovery metrics (probes recovered per stage)

These columns track the total number of distinct target loci/probes for which sequence data was successfully recovered at key stages of the workflow:

| Column Name | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| **`probes_in_seeds`** | Number of targeted probes matching intraseeds. |
| **`probes_in_assembly`** | Number of targeted probes that have at least a sequence variant after SAUTE assembly. |
| **`probes_in_alleles`** | Number of targeted probes left after allele selection. |
| **`probes_in_homologs`** | Number of targeted probes left after homolog filtering. |
| **`probes_in_separation`** | Final number of targeted probes found after region separation (final sequences). |

---

### Sequence yield metrics (median sequences per probe)

These columns report the median number of recovered sequences per targeted locus at each stage of the pipeline, providing insight into subgenome copy numbers and sample complexity:

| Column Name | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| **`median_seqs_per_probe_in_seeds`** | Median number of intraseeds recovered per probe. |
| **`median_seqs_per_probe_in_assembly`** | Median number of sequence variants per probe after SAUTE assembly. |
| **`median_seqs_per_probe_in_alleles`** | Median number of sequences per probe after allele selection. |
| **`median_seqs_per_probe_in_homologs`** | Median number of sequences per probe after homolog filtering. |
| **`median_seqs_per_probe_in_separation`** | Median number of sequences per probe after region separation (final sequences). |

::: {.callout-tip}
Comparing `probes_in_seeds` with `probes_in_separation` allows you to evaluate overall pipeline sensitivity, while tracking `median_seqs_per_probe_in_separation` gives a quick diagnostic of ploidy-level or gene copy number yielded across your samples.
:::
